_comment: Canonical BoundSessions document shape. client is the authority - it creates and updates this document to persist the bidirectional binding between a web session and one or more Operator sessions. A field mismatch breaks session binding, SSE routing, and Operator command dispatch.
_consumers: client internal services (session binding, SSE routing)

bound_sessions._description: Persisted record of the bidirectional binding between a web session and one or more Operator sessions. Created when operators are bound to a web session via the registration service.

web_session_id.description: Browser session ID that operators are bound to.

user_id.description: User ID who owns the web session.

operator_session_ids.description: Operator session IDs bound to this web session. Used for SSE event routing.

operator_ids.description: Operator document IDs bound to this web session.

bound_at.description: When the binding was first created.

last_updated_at.description: When the binding was last updated (operator added or removed).
